description: Draft a source-conscious proposal about stimuli, sensory perception, music/sound-based interventions, technology or the SSTIM reference. Never submits or validates claims.

description.description: What is wrong, needed, or proposed (max 4000 characters)

evidence.description: Source URLs, citations, counterexamples or supporting details (not automatically verified)

kind.description: Kind of proposed improvement or research need

release.description: Optional frozen SSTIM ontology release x.y.z

reproduction.description: Reproduction steps, observed behavior or specific use case

stance.description: Epistemic status of the proposed assertion

targetIri.description: Optional affected public HTTPS term/resource IRI
